mapper.select: SELECT PII.INDEX_ID indexId, PII.INCOME_TYPE incomeType, PII.INCOME_TARGET incomeTarget, TEMP.EFF_DATE effDate FROM (SELECT PTL_STGY_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, MAX(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{date,jdbcType=DATE} AND PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, PTL_STGY_ID )TEMP INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL PPE ON PPE.PTL_STGY_ID = TEMP.PTL_STGY_ID AND PPE.EVAL_INDEX = '${EVAL_INDEX_01}' INNER JOIN PTL_INCOME_INDEX PII ON PII.INDEX_ID = PPE.INDEX_ID order by TEMP.EFF_DATE DESC
